additional_info.subject: RE: 0411877 - ID0411877-DC/Si-D/FR- [ Y2 / PD 312571675/22] Firmware Update CRM:02023000541
additional_info.body:
Hello RC FR-Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / PD 312571675/22
Charger ID/Serial No.:
yrTycA
Problem Description:
Firmware Update to 6.0.3 & SCB offline (Disconnection) while updating the FW remotely.
Troubleshooting:
Charger is updated to FW 5.0.23 & there seems to be an issue with router1 connectivity.
It can be either LAN cable or router failure. Need to have an intervention.
Charger FW update: 2025-03-13T05:57:11.053522+00:00 sicharge-cp [daemon:info] sh[491]: booted image version: v5.0.23-0-ga7b036a 2024-12-05 08:47:27+00:00,2025-03-13 13:43:39.058,
Please refer below troubleshooting steps:
It might be a hardware issue. If so, the problem could be with
Router itself
LAN Cable
loose connection.
12V power supply to the router.
Please plan an onsite visit to check these components. We recommend carrying a spare router, LAN Cable & SIM card and replacing it if necessary.
Additionally, please update the charger to FW V 6.0.3 on site.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
1/5/2025
, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
